blocks.x: Right ahead, Paul. Okay, well, I'll put my name on that first to show you what I'm on. My name is Dick Allen. Paul? Paul Crawford.
Lorena Diggs. And Carrie Diggs Boot.
Carrie Diggs Boot. Uh-huh. Okay, well, we'll keep y'all straight. I'll call you Ms. Diggs and you and Ms. Boot.
Okay, all right. So, Ms. Diggs, when were you born?
